 Lee Seo-jin, Ha Ji-won, and others apply sunscreen… 'Damo' chemistry after 23 years
 By Eun Lee

 Published

 Actor Lee Seo-jin showed a tender side by personally applying sunscreen to Ha Ji-won’s back.
 On the SBS variety show 'Will You Do Anything for Me, Secretary Jin?' broadcast on the 6th, Ha Ji-won and Gangnam were seen filming YouTube content together.
 During the episode, Ha Ji-won set out with Gangnam to ride the Giant Swing in Singapore.
 Actor Lee Seo-jin showed a tender side by personally applying sunscreen to Ha Ji-won’s back. /Photo=SBS 'Will You Do Anything for Me, Secretary Jin?' broadcast screen 
 Before riding the Giant Swing, Ha Ji-won said, "I got sunburned," and suggested, "Let's apply some sunscreen first."
 While applying sunscreen to her own arms and the front of her neck, Ha Ji-won asked Lee Seo-jin, "Could you please apply a little on the back of my neck?"
 In response, Lee Seo-jin immediately applied sunscreen to the back of Ha Ji-won’s neck and her back. He was seen holding her hair with one hand to prevent sunscreen from getting into it, applying it meticulously.
 As he applied the sunscreen, Lee Seo-jin remarked, "You got sunburned. You look darker. But you were already a bit dark to begin with, weren't you?" Ha Ji-won also expressed concern, saying, "I did get sunburned."
 The scene evoked memories of the 2003 drama 'Damo,' in which the two had previously appeared together.
 Kim Kwang-gyu, who was watching, said, "My mouth was itching, but I held back. It would have been funny if he had applied it while saying, 'Does it hurt? I hurt too,'" eliciting laughter.
 When the production team asked, "Do you think Lee Seo-jin will parody 'Damo' in Singapore?" Kim Kwang-gyu responded, "I won't do that damn thing," causing everyone to burst into laughter.
